findings.details: The capture contract accepts a structural VerifiedSlackChannelBinding object with a caller-supplied verifiedSlackEnvelope=true marker, while buildSourceLedgerRows locally synthesizes signatureVerification and replayVerification hashes and aliases providerEventId from transportDeliveryId.
